import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 2002;
    static final int INF = 1000;
    
    static int[][] cap = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[MAXN];
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAXN];
    static int[] par = new int[MAXN];
    
    static int[][] dirs = {{1,0}, {0,1}, {-1,0}, {0,-1}};
    
    static int dfs(int u, int sink, int flow) {
        if (u == sink) return flow;
        visited[u] = true;
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (!visited[v] && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                int f = dfs(v, sink, Math.min(flow, cap[u][v]));
                if (f > 0) {
                    par[v] = u;
                    return f;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int max_flow(int src, int sink, int nodes) {
        int total = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            Arrays.fill(par, -1);
            int f = dfs(src, sink, INF);
            if (f == 0) break;
            total += f;
            for (int v = sink; v != src; v = par[v]) {
                int u = par[v];
                cap[u][v] -= f;
                cap[v][u] += f;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int dim = sc.nextInt();
        int time_limit = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; ++j)
                cap[i][j] = 0;
        }
        
        String[] sci = new String[dim];
        String[] cap_str = new String[dim];
        int[][][] vert = new int[dim][dim][2];
        int bad_cell = -1;
        
        int next_node = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            sci[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                char c = sci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int node = next_node++;
                    cap[0][node] = c - '0';
                    adj[0].add(node);
                    adj[node].add(0);
                    vert[i][j][0] = node;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    bad_cell = 100 * i + j;
                    sci[i] = sci[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + sci[i].substring(j + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int max_node = next_node;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            cap_str[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                char c = cap_str[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int node = max_node++;
                    cap[node][1] = c - '0';
                    adj[node].add(1);
                    vert[i][j][1] = node;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int[][] dist_bad = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(dist_bad[i], time_limit + 1);
        if (bad_cell != -1) {
            dist_bad[bad_cell / 100][bad_cell % 100] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(bad_cell);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int pos = q.poll();
                int x = pos / 100, y = pos % 100;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int nx = x + dirs[d][0], ny = y + dirs[d][1];
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim &&
                        sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && dist_bad[nx][ny] > dist_bad[x][y] + 1) {
                        dist_bad[nx][ny] = dist_bad[x][y] + 1;
                        q.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && sci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    int[][] dist_from = new int[dim][dim];
                    for (int x = 0; x < dim; ++x)
                        Arrays.fill(dist_from[x], time_limit + 1);
                    dist_from[i][j] = 0;
                    
                    if (cap_str[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && cap_str[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                        int u = vert[i][j][0], v = vert[i][j][1];
                        cap[u][v] = INF;
                        adj[u].add(v);
                        adj[v].add(u);
                    }
                    
                    Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                    q.offer(100 * i + j);
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int pos = q.poll();
                        int x = pos / 100, y = pos % 100;
                        
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + dirs[d][0], ny = y + dirs[d][1];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim &&
                                sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && dist_from[nx][ny] > dist_from[x][y] + 1) {
                                if (cap_str[nx].charAt(ny) >= '1' && cap_str[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9') {
                                    if (dist_from[x][y] + 1 <= dist_bad[nx][ny]) {
                                        int src_node = vert[i][j][0];
                                        int dst_node = vert[nx][ny][1];
                                        cap[src_node][dst_node] = INF;
                                        adj[src_node].add(dst_node);
                                        adj[dst_node].add(src_node);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (dist_from[x][y] + 1 < dist_bad[nx][ny]) {
                                    dist_from[nx][ny] = dist_from[x][y] + 1;
                                    q.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow(0, 1, 2 * dim * dim + 2));
    }
}
